question: Do the two-dimensional harmonic carrier and uniform-source cancellation uniquely select the observed (2,1) graphite angles?

objects.definition: connected periodic honeycomb on torus with N hexagonal faces
objects.metric_measure: unit Euclidean only for harmonic representative

objects.definition: M columns span harmonic edge subspace; W diagonal edge weights
objects.exact_expression: W=wI implies S_N=w(B1 M)^T=0 for every toroidal N

objects.definition: DFT-derived rigid first-harmonic estimates in Lebedeva et al. Table 6
objects.origin: external primary source, not measured force
objects.uncertainty: source rounding, DFT method/model discrepancy, no experimental error

sources.section_or_object_id: Abstract: sharp peaks at 21.8 and 38.2 degrees, other patterns no detectable signal, negligible load dependence vs coaligned
sources.source_status: primary abstract; full text and supplement subscription required
primary first-principles model; not measured kinetic friction

sources.section_or_object_id: Sec. I/II: paired geometry and seven-cell harmonic model

assumptions: periodic-torus: connected closed orientable honeycomb quotient with V=2N,E=3N,F=N, unit edge metric for harmonic M
rigid-first-harmonic: Table 6 source values apply to ideal rigid static sliding paths, not AFM kinetic force
conditional detection example: common positive alpha, common force threshold T across two contacts (not observed)

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: verify b1=2 for N=7,13,19 and B1B2=0
show uniform port cancellation independent of N

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: show detection contrast is not uniquely UD-attributable

dynamics_readout.generator_or_update: none derived for physical friction; candidate static source S_N(w)

dynamics_readout.physical_mapping: none from static shear to measured signed kinetic force

known_targets: other tested commensurate patterns below detection
fitted_parameters_or_formula_choices: Seven-cell carrier previously chosen from observed (2,1) geometry; no new fit
Detection alpha and threshold example are free hypothetical quantities, not estimated
target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: three predeclared N=7,13,19 quotient examples; two source-table patterns
target_exposure.selection_criterion: test uniqueness of harmonic selection and size of conventional static contrast
target_exposure.baseline: ordinary moire lattice and DFT-derived ideal static force

calculation_steps: Construct A-to-B incidence and six-edge oriented faces on periodic quotient indexed mod N; exactly check B1 B2=0 and rational ranks.
Use connectedness and orientability to derive ranks 2N-1,N-1 for every toroidal honeycomb; b1=2 independent of N.
For harmonic M, B1 M=0. Therefore M^T(wI)B1^T=0 for any N; the topology and uniform source do not uniquely select N=7.
Read source-rounded rigid DFT values from Lebedeva v1 Tables 2/6 and source-reported KC amplitudes in its text; compute ratios without adding experimental precision.
Under additional common-alpha threshold assumption only, solve alpha*tau31<T<=alpha*tau21; show conventional existence example, not prediction.

result.exact_expression: For connected toroidal honeycomb N, b1=2 and S_N(wI)=0; conditional common-threshold interval 6680 Pa<T/alpha<=13900 Pa
result.approximation: Source-rounded DFT corrugation (2,1)/(3,1) ≈12.85; ideal rigid shear ≈2.0808; KC-vs-DFT corrugation ratios ≈253 and ≈763
result.units: corrugation micro-eV/atom, ideal shear Pa, topology dimensionless
result.precision_and_error: exact chain ranks and algebra under topology assumptions; approximate source-rounded decimal ratios; no measured force uncertainty or detection threshold
result.scope: seven-cell topology alone fails to select observed pair; conventional static contrast is not a kinetic friction prediction
result.physical_interpretation: A restricted independently sourced N-dependent law and held-out signed force/readout are required for UD attribution

verification.method: constructor exact rational replay and source-table decimal arithmetic
verification.actual_result: PASS: 7/13/19 boundary square, ranks, Betti numbers; source-rounded ratios

counterexamples_and_failures: N=13 and N=19 each have the same b1=2 and uniform port cancellation as N=7, defeating uniqueness of the two-feature angle explanation.
A conditional conventional common-threshold map permits (2,1) detected and (3,1) undetected, so the binary angular contrast alone does not identify UD.
Lebedeva v1 Table 2 (~0.004 micro-eV/atom for (3,1) noisy profile) and Table 6 (0.0239 first-harmonic estimate) are method-specific, not interchangeable barrier measurements.
limitations: APS full article and supplement restricted; no measured signed force table, threshold, uncertainties, linewidths, complex self-energy, or contact mapping.
DFT and KC values compare PES corrugation under related but not identical computational setups; their ratio does not transfer directly to vertical Hessian or damping.
Three explicit incidence examples accompany a general torus proof; no general UD constitutive selection law is derived.
No independent physics review; attached CRL-2 governance text is a proposal, not an earned review status.
next_discriminant: Independently specify an N-dependent material source/loss rule and calibrated conventional force transfer; acquire signed paired-angle and other-moire force data with detection limits, load traces, and complex loss response.
